example:
import { EditorialFilterBar } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<EditorialFilterBar aria-label="Selection" value={tab} onValueChange={setTab} options={[{ value: "all", label: "Selected cards" }, { value: "down", label: "Price drops" }]} extra="vs. 30 days ago" />
name: EditorialFilterBar
tagline: A row of underlined filter toggles above a collection (gh#1435): a named `role="group"` of `aria-pressed` buttons (one pressed at a time) and a trailing note, over a hairline. The collection below is the consumer's. Geometry: `--editorial-filter-bar-*`.
usage: DO use Tabs when each option owns a panel; this bar only filters one collection.
